# Load

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(here)
library(limma)
library(edgeR)
library(mgcv)
library(janitor)
# library(patchwork)
library(DMRcate)
library(missMethyl)
# library(glmnet)
select <- dplyr::select
```

```{r}
GSE234354_counts <- readRDS(here("data/GSE234354_counts.rds"))
GSE234354_gene_annotations <- readRDS(here("data/GSE234354_gene_annotations.rds"))
m_values <- readRDS(here("cache/rwh_m_values.rds"))
all_m_values <- readRDS(here("data/GSE223817_m.rds"))
filtered_probe_info <- readRDS(here("cache/filtered_probe_info_epic_v1.rds"))
filtered_probe_info_v2 <- readRDS(here("cache/filtered_probe_info_epic_v2.rds"))
phenotype <- readRDS(here("data/methyl_phenotype_with_cell_props.rds"))
```


# Filtering


```{r}
rwh_pheno <- phenotype %>% filter(! is.na(sample_id), ! is.na(ever_pregnant))
rwh_pheno
```

```{r}
m_values <- m_values[filtered_probe_info$probe_id,rwh_pheno$geo_accession]
```

```{r}
dim(m_values)
```

```{r}
cl <- rwh_pheno %>% select(starts_with("cl")) %>% colnames()
cl
```

```{r}
stopifnot(colnames(m_values) == rwh_pheno$geo_accession)
colnames(m_values) <- rwh_pheno$sample_id
```

# Normalise counts

For visualisation purposes, remove batch effect

```{r}
# Normalise M-values
covariates <- model.matrix(~ sentrix_id + recruiment, data=phenotype)
all_m_values_norm <- limma::removeBatchEffect(all_m_values, covariates=covariates[,-1])

# Only use filtered probes
all_m_values_norm <- all_m_values_norm[rownames(m_values),]
```

```{r}
gc()
```

# Regularised fit

```{r}
pheno <- rwh_pheno %>%
  mutate(age_scaled=scale(age)[,1]) %>%
  mutate(cycle=case_when(
    time < 9 | time > 99 ~ "men",
    time < 59 ~ "pro",
    TRUE ~ "sec"
  ))  %>% 
  filter(! is.na(ever_pregnant)) %>%
  # filter(plate %in% ok_plates) %>%
  mutate(group=paste0(cycle, "_", ever_pregnant))
```


```{r}
k_knots <- 10
spline_knots <- list(x=seq(1,100,length=k_knots))
gamma <- 4
batch <- pheno$plate
x <- pheno$time

# 100k -> 15 mins
Sys.time()
set.seed(42)
subset_probes <- sample(1:nrow(m_values), 1e5)
#fit_summary_list <- lapply(1:nrow(m_values), \(i) {
fit_summary_list <- lapply(subset_probes, \(i) {
  y <- m_values[i, pheno$sample_id]
  fit <- gam(y ~ batch + s(x, bs="cc", k=k_knots, fx=FALSE), knots=spline_knots, gamma=gamma)
  fit_summary <- summary(fit)
  return(c(fit_summary$edf, fit_summary$r.sq))
})
Sys.time()

edf <- sapply(fit_summary_list, \(x) x[1])
quantile(edf, c(0.5, 0.9, 0.99, 0.999, 0.9999, 1))
hist(edf)
```
